notes: Adapted chemistry-12-2's own from-scratch latex2html.py converter and build_page.py template (same subject, no pre-existing exemplar for this specific chapter's content) after surveying this chapter's own LaTeX usage (chem3_latex_survey.txt) - added boldsymbol/dfrac/overline support, and the general '=' +  rac gluing (step_9 trap, documented as not yet implemented when chemistry-12-2 shipped). Code-generated rather than manual per-item design judgement, same reconciliation note as chemistry-12-2's own stage 9 entry. Six real bugs found and fixed during this build, all now fixed in the shared latex2html/serialize.py pipeline code (not just chapter-specific patches) except the first: (1) figure captions were only esc()-escaped, never LaTeX-converted, leaking raw $...$ math onto the page - fixed in build_page_chem3.py (template-specific, not yet ported to pipeline/); (2) pipeline/serialize.py's build_flow() silently dropped a :::table nested inside :::prompt (q_3.20, q_3.22 both have a data table alongside their own question) - only handled table/figure inside a solution's own flow, not a prompt's; fixed in pipeline/serialize.py; (3) pipeline/serialize.py's duplicate-whole-item-solution heuristic assumed ANY multi-part item's trailing item-level :::solution is redundant - wrong for q_3.15, whose 6 parts carry no solution of their own at all (the item-level solution, with its 2 figures, is the only real content); fixed to only suppress when at least one part actually has its own solution_blocks; (4) render.py bakes a literal '**उत्तर:**' markdown-bold prefix into every :::answer block for the plain-markdown path, which the boxed-answer pill was rendering as literal asterisks - stripped in the template; (5) convert_display_block's row-splitting regex required the block to START with  egin{...}, missing a real case with a 	ext{label} prefix before  egin{aligned} - the '&' column separators leaked as literal text; fixed to allow (and render) a prefix before the environment, and extended to gathered too; (6) the SAME '&' leak occurred separately for any INLINE (single $) occurrence of  egin{aligned}, which never reaches convert_display_block at all (a table header cell's own two-row label) - added a proper inline backstop in the tokenizer's own begin/end dispatch, with real row/column splitting; (7, found alongside #6) \left\{...ight\} - a matched brace-delimiter pair, not set-builder notation - rendered as literal backslash-brace text since _read_group's 2-char escaped-brace token was passed to a single-character escaper; fixed; (8) confirmed empirically that Chromium treats the boundary between plain text and an adjacent <sup>/<sub> as a valid line-break point independent of overflow-wrap/white-space - a boxed answer's own '10^{-3}' tore across two lines even with overflow-wrap:normal set directly on the box; fixed generally by gluing a short trailing base token to its own immediately-following exponent/subscript in one nowrap span (new .s91 class), not just chapter-specific manual patching.
